libs.note: BH-2538: every lane's context kill as an operator knob, so the console can set it. One knob per catalog/context-budgets.json lane that carries a kill or a kill basis; the settings row lib.context-kill.context_kill_tokens_<lane> overrides the manifest's context_kill_tokens for that lane, and the manifest number is the fallback when there is no row, the worker is unreachable and no row is cached, or the row is not a whole number. A row of 0 unarms the lane. CONTEXT_KILL_TOKENS (a caller's per-call override) still binds first. Applied by agent-call.sh with lib_env_apply context-kill; tests/context-kill-lanes.bh-2538-test.sh section S drives it.
